purpose: This form is used to apply for the conversion of a public company into a private company under section 14.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within sixty days from the date of passing of special resolution
steps: Pass a special resolution for the conversion at a general meeting.
Prepare the e-Form No. RD-1 with the required particulars.
Attach the required documents and declarations.
Pay the fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
File the application with the Regional Director within sixty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
checklist: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
A copy of the minutes of the general meeting with vote details and names of dissenters
A copy of the Board resolution or Power of Attorney dated not earlier than thirty days authorising the application
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and no deposit violations
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding compliance with sections 73 to 76A, 177, 178, 185, 186, and 188
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions under section 179(3) and delisting status
Particulars including dates of the Board and general meetings
Reasons for conversion and its effect on stakeholders
Details of any conversion made within the last five years and outcome along with a copy of the order
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney
Declaration by key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits
Declaration by key managerial personnel or director regarding non-compliance of specific sections
Declaration by key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and delisting
watch: The application must be filed within sixty days from the date of passing of the special resolution.
